title: Fancy Yellow radiant diamond earrings, platinum and yellow gold
subtitle: The radiant cut concentrates saturation. Its cropped corners and facet pattern hold Fancy Yellow color deeper and more fully than most other forms — the warmth reads at once rather than building. The baguette halo was designed to amplify that reading: white baguettes at the perimeter create a clean frame of contrast so the yellow at center presents its full saturation without interruption.
